name: Outline Fill
description: The second clip is colored in from its own outlines: they appear first as thin lines over the first clip, then its colors spread out from every outline with a soft, darker wet edge, and the widest plain areas fill in last. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: reach
params.description: How far the color spreads from the outlines, in frame heights; areas farther from any outline fill in at the end

params.name: threshold
params.description: Contrast needed around a pixel before the color reaches it: lower also spreads from faint edges
